intro: When someone searches for your business or your service in your area, Google shows your Business Profile: your name, rating, reviews, photos, opening hours, phone number and a button for directions. A complete, active profile earns calls and visits. An incomplete, outdated or suspended one quietly sends those customers to a competitor.

TopWebExpert has optimised and managed Google Business Profiles (formerly Google My Business) for clinics, restaurants, retailers, real estate firms, professional services and multi-branch businesses. We are a Delhi NCR agency headquartered in Gurugram, with an office in Noida and a branch in Melbourne, and in more than seven years of search marketing for 150+ clients we have seen almost every profile problem there is.

Our service is focused and practical. We audit your profile, fix what is broken, fill in what is missing, help you build a steady flow of reviews and, if you want, manage the profile every month so it keeps working.

sections.heading: Is Your Profile Costing You Customers?
paragraphs: Open your profile on your phone and look at it as a new customer would. If any of the following is true, there is work to do:
list: The primary category is generic, for example "Clinic" when you are a physiotherapy centre
Opening hours are missing, or holiday hours were never updated
There are only a few photos, they are blurry, or they were all uploaded by customers
Recent reviews have no reply from the business
The phone number goes to someone who has left, or to a line nobody answers
The pin on the map is in the wrong tower or on the wrong side of the road
There are two listings for the same business
The profile has been suspended, or you no longer have access to it
after: Each of these costs you visibility, trust or both. Most can be fixed within a few weeks.

sections.heading: What Our Google Business Profile Service Covers
sections.intro: Every task below is carried out within Google's guidelines. We never stuff keywords into your business name or use tactics that put your profile at risk.

items.title: Profile audit
items.text: A full review of your profile against your competitors: categories, services, information, photos, reviews, posts and how you rank in the map across your area.

items.title: Categories and services
items.text: The most accurate primary category and relevant secondary categories, with your services and products listed in plain, searchable language. Category choice has a strong effect on which searches you appear for.

items.title: Business information
items.text: Name exactly as on your signage, correct address or service area, phone, website link with tracking, hours, holiday hours and attributes such as parking or wheelchair access.

items.title: Photos and videos
items.text: A clear photo brief for your team or a shoot we arrange: exterior with signage, entrance, interior, team and work. Fresh photos help people recognise you and trust you.

items.title: Description and posts
items.text: A business description written for customers, and a calendar of posts for offers, news and events so searchers can see you are active.

items.title: Reviews and replies
items.text: A simple review request process using your profile's short link and QR code, reply templates for your team and a plan for handling negative or fake reviews properly.

items.title: Duplicates, access and verification
items.text: We help remove duplicate listings, recover profiles owned by former staff or agencies, and guide you through verification, which Google now often handles by video.

items.title: Suspension recovery
items.text: If your profile has been suspended, we find the likely cause, correct it and prepare a reinstatement request with the right evidence.

items.title: Monthly management
items.text: Optional ongoing service: regular posts, photo updates, review replies, Q&A monitoring, spam edits watch and a monthly performance report.

sections.heading: Google Business Profile and Local SEO
paragraphs: Your profile is the most visible part of local search, but it is not the only part. Google also looks at your website, how consistently your business details appear across the web, the reviews you collect and the local sites that mention you. That is why many businesses start with profile optimisation, because it gives the quickest visible improvement, and then continue with a full local SEO programme.

If you are not sure which you need, start with the free profile audit. We will tell you honestly whether profile work alone is enough, or whether your website and listings are holding you back as well.

sections.heading: How We Measure Success
paragraphs: Google's profile performance data shows how many people found you, which searches they used, and how many called, asked for directions, visited your website or booked. We record these numbers before we start and compare them month by month.

We also add tracking to your website link so visits from your profile show up separately in Google Analytics, and track calls and WhatsApp clicks from that traffic. That way you can see exactly what the profile contributes to your enquiries.

sections.heading: Who This Service Is For
paragraphs: Google Business Profile optimisation suits any business that meets customers at its premises or serves a defined local area: clinics and hospitals, restaurants and cafés, salons and gyms, showrooms and retailers, real estate brokers, schools and coaching centres, professional firms and home-service businesses. It is especially valuable for businesses with several branches, where each location needs its own accurate, active profile.
If your business is online-only, with no premises and no local service area, you are usually not eligible for a profile under Google's guidelines, and we will recommend a different approach.

sections.heading: Common Mistakes That Hold Profiles Back
paragraphs: Many of the profiles we audit have been set up with good intentions and then left alone, or edited in ways that work against the business. These are the mistakes we see most often, and the reason we fix them before doing anything else:
list: Adding city names or service keywords to the business name. It can bring a short-term lift, but it breaks Google's guidelines and is one of the most common causes of suspension.
Choosing a broad primary category because it sounds bigger. A precise category almost always matches more of the searches that lead to customers.
Using a co-working desk or virtual office address as a storefront. If customers cannot visit you there during your listed hours, the profile is at risk.
Letting different people edit the profile with no record of changes, so the phone number, hours or website link end up wrong.
Buying reviews or offering rewards for five-star ratings. Google filters and removes these, and can restrict new reviews on the profile.
Ignoring the questions and answers section, where anyone, including competitors, can post an answer on your behalf.
after: Fixing these issues does not just protect the profile. It usually improves how often it appears, because Google trusts the information more.

items.q: Is Google Business Profile the same as Google My Business?
items.a: Yes. Google renamed Google My Business to Google Business Profile. The service, the listing and the way it appears in Search and Maps are the same.

items.q: Our profile was suspended. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. We first correct anything that breaks Google's guidelines, such as keywords in the business name or an ineligible address, then prepare a reinstatement request with supporting evidence like signage photos and registration documents.

items.q: Can you remove a bad review?
items.a: Only Google can remove reviews, and only when they break its policies, for example spam, conflicts of interest or offensive content. We help you report those. For genuine complaints, a calm and factual reply usually does more good than removal.

items.q: We work from home or a residential building. Can we still have a profile?
items.a: Yes, as a service-area business, if you visit customers at their location. You hide your address and list the areas you serve. You should not show a home address as a storefront if customers do not visit.

items.q: How much does Google Business Profile optimisation cost?
items.a: It depends on the number of locations, whether there are ownership or suspension issues and whether you want ongoing management. We quote a fixed price after the free audit.

items.q: Will you need my Google account password?
items.a: No. You add us as a manager on the profile, so you keep full ownership and can remove our access at any time.

items.q: How quickly will I see results?
items.a: Corrections to categories, information and photos often show an effect within a few weeks. Review growth and ranking improvements build over the following months.
